reason: E2 and E3 support solute segregation and the formation of a nano-bridged honeycomb structure, but no cited evidence supports the claim that spinodal decomposition of a supersaturated B2 phase drives this, nor that this microstructure directly improves toughness and yield strength.
premises: Solute segregation during L-PBF solidification enriches Ni and Al at cell boundaries in Al0.5CrCoFeNi
Spinodal decomposition of the supersaturated B2 phase occurs on these cell boundaries
This process forms a nano-bridged honeycomb microstructure
The nano-bridged honeycomb microstructure improves intrinsic toughness and yield strength
